description: This file defines various classes and traits for executing streaming triggers in Apache Spark, including single, multiple, and time-based batch execution strategies.

classes.name: TriggerExecutor
classes.description: A trait defining the interface for trigger executors that run streaming batches.

classes.name: SingleBatchExecutor
classes.description: Executes a single batch and then terminates.

classes.name: ProcessingTimeExecutor
classes.description: Executes batches at fixed time intervals, with logging for falling behind.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the trigger execution process, implementation varies by class.

methods.name: setNextBatch
methods.description: Sets the execution context for the next batch.

methods.name: runOneBatch
methods.description: Runs a single batch using the provided batch runner.

methods.name: notifyBatchFallingBehind
methods.description: Logs a warning when a batch is falling behind schedule.

methods.name: nextBatchTime
methods.description: Calculates the start time for the next batch interval based on current time.
